result:
The audit warning on `PostController.store` is gone, and `bunx guren gate` still passes, including the tests. `store` now uses `Post.create(fields, { set: { authorId: author.id } })`, so the request data never reaches a force write and the author is still set from the session.

The audit still reports two dependency advisories, `katex` (warning) and `source-map-js` (failure). Both come from packages this change does not touch, so I left them alone. Updating `source-map-js` would be a separate dependency change if you want it.
